versions.name: Camp Weidman
versions.address: 3806 S Vandecar Rd, Mount Pleasant, MI 48858
versions.summary: A Michigan Crossroads Council camp west of Mount Pleasant, Michigan, used by units and districts for weekend camping, camporees, and outdoor leader training.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Michigan Crossroads Council site, which lists Camp Weidman as an active location hosting a 2026 district fall camporee and IOLS leader training. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own event-location page (2026 camporee and training scheduled); camp_type/program_types classified conservatively; features unsurveyed.
